scene: You step off the sleigh tram into snowy, glittering Snow Globe Works.
picture: Pixel art flat side view along a snowy cobblestone street. Far left, the wooden sleigh tram rests on brass runners. Left, an open workshop door glows warm. Centre, a lanky boy in an orange vest, white scarf and back kite stands beside a pedestal with a brass key. Far right sits a glass-domed cart.
shown: a warm wooden shopfront with an open blue door on the left
a huge brass wind-up key turning slowly in a glass pedestal centre
a red vendor cart loaded with glowing snow globes on the far right
